Gating the matrix on the branch name reintroduces the EXACT CMX-314 production regression through a key no assertion in the file touches: on `cmx-N` the matrix is [3.11, 3.12] and CI is green; on `dev`, `main`, `release/*` or a docs branch it becomes [3.99], the pinned `Set up Python` step runs `uv python install 3.99`, and every non-cmx-N PR — including the dev->main promotion PR this PR was written to unbreak — goes red again. The PR's own catalog entry asserts this key is already covered — 'rather than the `runs-on`/`strategy`/`steps` keys pinned individually today' — but no test in the repo reads `strategy` or `runs-on` at all.

WIRING — the entire delivery vehicle for every invariant in tests/test_ci_workflow.py is `on: pull_request:`, and nothing in the repo reads the workflow's triggers. Every test in the file resolves through `workflow['jobs']`; the `on:` block is never inspected (and under PyYAML it isn't even reachable as `workflow['on']` — the bare `on` key parses to the boolean True, so a check written the obvious way would KeyError). Narrowing `pull_request` to a base-branch filter that matches nothing makes the `test` job never run on any pull request at all: the CMX-301 defeat-shape numbering guard, the ref-state assertion, the pinned step list, Pytest itself — none of it executes on a PR ever again, and GitHub reports the PR as having no required CI rather than a red one. This is the same end state rounds 6, 9 and 13 were each written to close ('CI reports green having executed zero tests'), reached one level above where any assertion looks. Verified on the mutated YAML: it parses, `set(workflow['jobs']) == {'test'}`, `jobs.test.steps` is byte-for-byte identical to `_EXPECTED_STEPS`, the job carries no `if:` and no `continue-on-error`, and no `env:` at any level names GITHUB_HEAD_REF/GITHUB_REF_NAME — so every assertion in the file is untouched.
